title: Test-object affine tensor base change
statement: For fixed affine charts and a fixed test morphism t:L→T satisfying the displayed compatibility, the restricted base-change arrow is isomorphic to Spec(id_A ⊗_R φ).

source.place: Schemes, Tag 01JR (lemma-open-fibre-product) and Tag 01I4 (lemma-fibre-product-affine-schemes); Limits, proof of Tag 01ZO, affine reduction.

proof.text: Use pullbackLeftPullbackSndIso to identify the pullback along t followed by d with the iterated pullback. Its two projections give a cartesian square over T, natural in f₀. The equation hq implies that the target chart lies over d⁻¹(W); its inverse image under f_T also lies there. Apply Scheme.Hom.isPullback_resLE to both cartesian squares. The restricted structure maps equal q and f_T|V_T followed by q by cancellation of the base-open inclusion. The two isoPullback maps yield an arrow isomorphism to pullback.map of the restricted arrow, checking its two projections.

Transport this pullback arrow by e0, eB, eC and e. The source structural-map compatibility follows from hC, hB and φ.comp_algebraMap. Construct pullback isomorphisms explicitly with pullback.map of the chart isomorphisms and their inverses. Compose with pullbackSymmetry and pullbackSpecIso R A B or R A C. Their inverse projections are Spec of the tensor inclusions followed by the chart inverses. The tensor map id_A ⊗ φ commutes with these inclusions; pullback.hom_ext therefore gives the arrow-isomorphism equation. Compose the geometric and algebraic arrow isomorphisms.

lean.statement:
theorem affine_base_piece_tensor_base_change_instance
    {S T : Scheme.{u}} (d : T ⟶ S)
    (X₀ Y₀ : Over S) (f₀ : X₀ ⟶ Y₀)
    (V : Y₀.left.Opens) (W : S.Opens)
    (R B C : CommRingCat.{u}) (aB : R →+* B) (aC : R →+* C)
    (e0 : (d ⁻¹ᵁ W).toScheme ≅ Spec R)
    (q : ((pullback.fst Y₀.hom d) ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme ⟶ (d ⁻¹ᵁ W).toScheme)
    (hq : q ≫ (d ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι =
      ((pullback.fst Y₀.hom d) ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι ≫ pullback.snd Y₀.hom d)
    (eB : ((pullback.fst Y₀.hom d) ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme ≅ Spec B)
    (eC : ((((Over.pullback d).map f₀).left) ⁻¹ᵁ
      ((pullback.fst Y₀.hom d) ⁻¹ᵁ V)).toScheme ≅ Spec C)
    : letI : Algebra R B := aB.toAlgebra
      letI : Algebra R C := aC.toAlgebra
      ∀ (φ : B →ₐ[R] C),
        eB.hom ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom aB) = q ≫ e0.hom →
        eC.hom ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ.toRingHom) =
          ((((Over.pullback d).map f₀).left) ∣_
            ((pullback.fst Y₀.hom d) ⁻¹ᵁ V)) ≫ eB.hom →
        ∀ (L : Scheme.{u}) (t : L ⟶ T) (A : CommRingCat.{u})
          (aA : Algebra R A) (e : (t ⁻¹ᵁ (d ⁻¹ᵁ W)).toScheme ≅ Spec A),
          t.resLE (d ⁻¹ᵁ W) _ le_rfl ≫ e0.hom =
            e.hom ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R A)) →
          Nonempty
            (Arrow.mk ((((Over.pullback (t ≫ d)).map f₀).left) ∣_
              ((pullback.fst Y₀.hom (t ≫ d)) ⁻¹ᵁ V)) ≅
              Arrow.mk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
                (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id R A) φ).toRingHom)))
